control_assignments.csv.control_concept: wrong concept used for the control
control_assignments.csv.control_type: control family assigned before scoring hidden-state similarities
control_assignments.csv.lexical_similarity: surface-form lexical score between query and control
control_assignments.csv.sstar_similarity: S* similarity between query concept and control concept

control_summary.csv.best_layer_name: descriptive best layer by paired_delta; not a primary selector
control_summary.csv.mid_p_perm_greater: mean layer-level sign-flip p-value over the mid-layer band
control_summary.csv.mid_paired_delta: mean paired_delta over the fixed mid-layer band

controls_by_layer.csv.ci_high: bootstrap 97.5% bound over concept-level paired deltas
controls_by_layer.csv.ci_low: bootstrap 2.5% bound over concept-level paired deltas
controls_by_layer.csv.control_score: mean cosine similarity for matched wrong-control concept
controls_by_layer.csv.control_type: random, close_neighbor, far_neighbor, lexical, or category_proxy
controls_by_layer.csv.format_a: source prompt spoke; __mean__ rows average format pairs
controls_by_layer.csv.format_b: target prompt spoke; __mean__ rows average format pairs
controls_by_layer.csv.layer: integer layer index; 0 is embedding for current hidden-state files
controls_by_layer.csv.matched_score: mean cosine similarity for same concept across spokes
controls_by_layer.csv.p_perm_greater: one-sided paired sign-flip p-value for positive delta
controls_by_layer.csv.retrieval_margin: same-concept similarity minus best nonself similarity
controls_by_layer.csv.retrieval_top1: same-concept retrieval top-1 among all concepts
controls_by_layer.csv.retrieval_top5: same-concept retrieval top-5 among all concepts
